title: Infinitesimal Operator World Models: Finite-Sample Guarantees for Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2511.10383v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Continuous-time stochastic processes underlie many natural and engineered systems. In healthcare, autonomous driving, and industrial control, direct interaction with the environment is often unsafe or impractical, motivating offline reinforcement learning from historical data. However, there is limited statistical understanding of the approximation errors inherent in learning policies from offline datasets. We address this by linking reinforcement learning to the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation and proposing an operator-theoretic algorithm based on a simple dynamic programming recursion. Specifically, we represent our world model in terms of the infinitesimal generator of controlled diffusion processes learned in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. translated_title: 无穷小算子世界模型：离线强化学习的有限样本保证
translated_abstract: 连续时间随机过程是许多自然系统与工程系统的基础。在医疗保健、自动驾驶和工业控制等领域，与环境的直接交互往往是不安全或不切实际的，这促使人们从历史数据中进行离线强化学习。然而，对于从离线数据集中学习策略所固有的近似误差，目前的统计学理解仍然有限。我们通过将强化学习与哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼（HJB）方程联系起来来解决这一问题，并提出了一种基于简单动态规划递归的算子理论算法。具体而言，我们以受控扩散过程的无穷小生成元来表示世界模型，并在再生核希尔伯特空间中对其进行学习。通过融合统计学习方法与算子理论，我们在生成元近似误差足够小的条件下建立了值函数的全局收敛性，并由此推导出有限样本保证……
tldr: 该论文将强化学习与HJB方程相联系，提出基于受控扩散过程无穷小生成元（在再生核希尔伯特空间中学习）的算子理论世界模型，在生成元近似误差足够小时证明了值函数的全局收敛性，并为离线强化学习提供了有限样本保证。
en_tdlr: This paper links reinforcement learning to the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation and proposes an operator-theoretic world model based on the infinitesimal generator of controlled diffusion processes learned in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, establishing global convergence of the value function and finite-sample guarantees for offline RL under sufficiently small generator-approximation error.
